verdict.rationale: Amplitude docs confirm dashboards, charts, and insights (funnels, segmentation) exist and a Dashboard REST API exposes chart data as JSON, implying dashboard composition, but no evidence explicitly describes saving/composing multiple insights into a shareable team dashboard or sharing/permissions workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of assembling multiple saved charts into one dashboard, sharing dashboards with team members/permissions, and any hands-on or community confirmation of this workflow.
